scientific_integrity.limitations: Exact singular spectrum for full two-by-two invertible locus only; no eigenphases, no higher-dimensional generalization or complete historical priority certificate. Infinite theorem derived from exact rank-dependent Fourier sums, permutation character decomposition and Schur orthogonality, not finite numerics.
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: The accompanying check_spectrum.py verifies the four smallest tested prime-power fields including a nonprime field and compares complete full-matrix singular spectra.

title: Exact three-level spectrum of self-restricted Fourier sampling on invertible two-by-two matrices
